description: Délimitation maritime - Délimitation avec accord is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by services.data.shom.fr. The theme “Maritime Delimitation with Agreement” contains the lines of separation between maritime areas of sovereignty and/or jurisdiction of France and neighbouring States, established by ratification of a delimitation agreement or by decision of an arbitral tribunal or international court empowered to deal with cases under the law of the sea. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime delimitation – Delimitation with agreement" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include délimitation maritime internationale, accord de délimitation maritime, droit de la mer, réglementation, données ouvertes. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2020-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
